physical.title: mask ('jipae'); ceremonial equipment
physical.summary: 'Jipae' body mask comprising of a basketry bodice, sago leaf sleeves and skirt; head piece of plaited string decorated with red and white pigment and with two protruding eyes terminating in oval wood discs edged with black and white feathers.
